verdict: Renderer and strict read-side design accepted with two concrete fixture/source-closure corrections required before prospective integration; this is not resulting-source execution qualification.

findings.conclusion: Canonical Host selection resolves the actual roster lead, preferring a nonremoved lead and otherwise retaining the original removed lead. No lead means no invented team-lead read. Existing member selector, toolbar/search/clear/stream/kind controls are reused. Raw getClaudeLogs controller is disabled for Host, including loadOlder/applyPending paths; it supplies only persisted presentation state.

Compact body is unmounted while fullscreen is open; dialog receives enabled=open and shares presentation state. CollapsibleTeamSection default does not keep children mounted while closed. MemberLogsTab combines enabled with the existing active-tab guard and unchanged member-log scope/coordinator. Original settlement-based poll has no overlap, disposes subscriptions/timer on source/scope/unmount and refuses obsolete delivery. Host member reads now continue while an owned viewer is active; background error retains the same-source value and shows the error.

Dedup sorts by sequence before filtering, scopes text/thinking by input plus child identity plus kind/messageRef/block, and does not replace completed content with a late snapshot. Tool/result association is input/child/toolRef-specific. Real text/Thinking, structured tool input/result, actual isError, child grouping, explicit gaps, current viewport and expanded-state restoration use original UI components without fake transcript chunks or native clocks. Existing Markdown copy receives real text; new source tests check copied bytes and tool result content.

Only actual process-output facts receive stderr provenance. Unmarked SDK/HTTP facts retain the legacy pass-through semantics under stream selection. Query/kind filtering occurs after dedup; gaps remain visible. Process events dedup by eventId so separate equal lines survive. Search/tool/result rendering remains subject to original projected content bounds.

All five shared primitives are byte-identical except export. The extracted activity block preserves existing finite/state/member/cursor/page/content limits; declared changes are thinking, top-level stderr only, and rejection of nested or input-attributed process output. Stderr additionally has a 24KiB UTF-8 limit and rejects NUL. Unknown/private fields are discarded. Data validation occurs before constructing other event fields, with no observed acceptance broadening. DTO/shared types exclude nested process output.

The adapter still filters by original input and hashes exact content for sourceGeneration. Thinking/output count once per distinct original messageRef within each input. Member-only stderr is excluded from exact Task data, source generation and counts. Original stale/currentness/history negative assertions remain; new tests cover exact thinking bytes and stale mutation plus stderr exclusion.

All deleted lines in the five reviewed test diffs are imports/mock adaptation or equivalent formatting of the existing launch guard; no prior behavioral assertion was removed. New tests use actual HostMemberActivityLog, Markdown, viewport hook, MemberLogsTab/completion hook or production facade where stated; Section-only route ownership tests mock data readers and do not by themselves prove native execution.

Original stream partial/no-terminal and single release remain. Added Team Logs controls read the retained event and assert unchanged original input/commands/provider-effect counters; real stderr is shown only for existing Claude/Codex finite peers, excluded from exact Task logs. Existing reload and Stop/currentness/cleanup gates remain. Collaboration reads the actual Bob member log without creating another business turn.
